text: Ophthalmology is a clinical discipline that studies the anatomy, physiology, and pathology of visual organs (the eyeball, ocular appendages, and related nervous systems), as well as the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of ocular diseases. As an important branch of the medical field, it not only involves microsurgical techniques (such as cataract surgery and corneal transplantation), but also covers the drug treatment of intraocular diseases (such as glaucoma and diabetic retinopathy), and intersects with neuroscience, genetics and other fields, dedicated to protecting and restoring human visual function.
